summary: Refresh least-privilege PostgreSQL application grants after owner-only migrations.
userImpact: Database migration and application identities can remain separate across upgrades.

instructions: Create a restricted runtime login separately, then configure the optional migration-only runtime role setting.

configuration: database.migration.runtimeRole supplies EG_POSTGRES_RUNTIME_ROLE only to the migration job; unset preserves existing behavior.

notes: PostgreSQL only: refresh current table CRUD grants, read-only migration ledger and bounded sequence permissions after migrations; future tables default to read-only until the next refresh.

security: Reject privileged, owning, member, or schema-creating runtime roles; do not grant DDL, role administration, bypass-RLS, TRUNCATE, or sequence UPDATE.
knownLimitations: This setting is PostgreSQL-only and does not create roles or change their credentials.
rollback: Unset the migration-only setting to stop grant refresh; existing grants remain and require explicit operator revocation if needed.
validation: PostgreSQL 16 real-role privilege integration, migration-runner unit tests, backend typecheck, raw SQL guard, Helm scope/lint and release-note preflight.
